title: Gold has an owner, a classification, and no consumers.
line: Ownership to groups, a small governed-tag taxonomy, and consumers kept out of gold.
points: Schemas by purpose: gold · semantic · governance · ops
Tags: sgw_pii · sgw_region_scope · sgw_sensitivity
Consumers: USE CATALOG only

deep.title: Classify once
deep.code:
ALTER TABLE gold.dim_customer ALTER COLUMN email SET TAGS ('sgw_pii' = 'email');
ALTER SCHEMA gold OWNER TO `wk_data_engineers`;

title: Security lives in the data, not in the tool.
line: Two ABAC policies on the gold schema protect every tagged column, for every consumer.
points: Rows filtered by sales region
PII masked unless you're a PII reader
Evaluated as whoever asks

deep.title: Row filter policy
deep.code:
CREATE POLICY region_rls ON SCHEMA sgw_shop.gold
  ROW FILTER governance.region_filter TO `account users`
  FOR TABLES MATCH COLUMNS has_tag_value('sgw_region_scope','region') AS r
  USING COLUMNS (r);

title: One definition per KPI. Security inherited.
line: Metric Views define every KPI once, as code. Consumers get SELECT on them, and nothing on gold.
points: 18 measures: filtered, composed, window, LOD
Synonyms ES · PT · EN for people and agents
Read gold with owner rights, filtered as you

deep.title: A composed window measure
deep.code:
- name: net_sales_ly
  expr: SUM(source.gross_amount - source.discount)
  window: [{order: month, range: current, offset: -12 month}]
- name: net_sales_yoy_pct
  expr: (MEASURE(net_sales) - MEASURE(net_sales_ly)) / MEASURE(net_sales_ly)

title: Any agent, same rules.
line: Claude, ChatGPT or Power BI sign the person in and call Databricks with that person's token. This app lives inside Databricks and plays that client, through the same MCP endpoints.
points: Sign in once: SSO, one token per person (OBO)
MCP: Genie One for answers, DBSQL for your own SQL
Unity Catalog filters, masks and audits every call

deep.title: The call every MCP client makes
deep.code:
POST https://<workspace>/ai-gateway/mcp-services/system.ai.dbsql
Authorization: Bearer <OAuth token of the person>   ← OBO

{"jsonrpc": "2.0", "method": "tools/call",
 "params": {"name": "execute_sql",
   "arguments": {"query": "SELECT region, MEASURE(net_sales)\n     FROM sgw_shop.semantic.sales_metrics GROUP BY ALL"},
   "_meta": {"warehouse_id": "<id>"}}}
